scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/. dist/ && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && oxfmt --check && npm run lint && node scripts/check-style.mjs src tests && node --experimental-transform-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test 'src/**/*.test.ts' 'scripts/**/*.test.mjs'
